findings.observed_behavior: GET request for binary file '/update_agent.exe' to host 'update-portal-cdn.xyz'
findings.why_suspicious: Adversaries frequently deliver second-stage implants, drop-executables, or tools via direct unencrypted HTTP requests.
findings.alternative_benign_explanations: Legitimate legacy software update or internal administrative installer fetch over HTTP.
findings.recommended_follow_up: Investigate endpoint process creation logs (Sysmon EID 1) around timestamp; acquire downloaded file if available to compute hash.

findings.observed_behavior: Outbound DNS query for domain 'update-portal-cdn.xyz' (resolved to ['198.51.100.44'])
findings.why_suspicious: High-abuse TLDs (.xyz) are commonly registered by threat actors for low-cost, short-lived delivery or C2 infrastructure.
findings.alternative_benign_explanations: Benign web navigation to a legitimate business website utilizing the .xyz TLD.
findings.recommended_follow_up: Check passive DNS history for domain; query endpoint proxy/web browsing logs for referer URL.

findings.observed_behavior: TLS ClientHello SNI header requesting server name 'beacon-c2.net'
findings.why_suspicious: Observed TLS SNI matches suspected command-and-control server naming patterns.
findings.alternative_benign_explanations: Coincidental naming in internal testing or legitimate telemetry service.
findings.recommended_follow_up: Inspect active network connections and memory artifacts of the source host for injected beacon threads.
